scope: existing6characters x Idle/basic action =12 sequences,8frames each
known_issues: Raw source files still contain painted checkerboards; use normalized_file for corrected sprites.
Generated pose/face/cloth consistency still requires visual approval; technical normalization does not redraw these.
Unity Sprite pivot/PPU, actual clip duration and impact timing have not been changed or play-tested.
runtime_notes: Old production reference sheets are4frames, but actual legacy Unity .anim keys vary by character.
Frame count must not automatically double clip duration.
Damage/heal/shield is applied by combat coroutine delays; no animation-event retiming performed.
8frame attack key pose nearframe5 is a visual proposal, not a new combat timing rule.

normalization.method: connected neutral-background mask, conservative internal checker detection, eight components, per-character common nearest-neighbor scale and foot anchor
